title: Python → Interview Ready Study Hub
tagline: From first script to FDE and SWE interviews: roughly 12 months at 7-8 hours a week.

tracks.title: Python Basics
tracks.description: Core Python from first script to small projects: control flow, functions, data structures, files and errors, comprehensions and generators. Every week has exercises checked by tests.

weeks.title: Week 1 · First steps
weeks.blurb: Running Python, variables, types and basic input and output.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Conditions and loops
weeks.blurb: Booleans, comparisons, if/elif/else, for and while loops.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Functions
weeks.blurb: Defining and calling functions, parameters, return values and scope.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Lists, tuples, strings
weeks.blurb: Sequences in depth: indexing, slicing, methods and string handling.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Dictionaries and sets
weeks.blurb: Hash-based collections, the workhorses of interview problems.

weeks.title: Week 6 · Files, errors, modules
weeks.blurb: Reading and writing files, exceptions, and organising code into modules.

weeks.title: Week 7 · Comprehensions and generators
weeks.blurb: Comprehensions, lambda, iterators and generators.

weeks.title: Week 8 · Projects and review
weeks.blurb: Two small projects plus a Stage 1 review of weeks 1-7.

tracks.title: Object-Oriented Python
tracks.description: Classes, encapsulation, inheritance and polymorphism, composition and design patterns, ending with a parking-lot design project.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Classes and objects
weeks.blurb: Why classes, attributes, methods and object state.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Encapsulation and dunders
weeks.blurb: Conventions for privacy, properties and special methods.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Inheritance and polymorphism
weeks.blurb: Inheritance and super(), abstract base classes and the MRO.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Composition and design patterns
weeks.blurb: Composition over inheritance, dataclasses, enums, protocols, SOLID and common patterns.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Project: parking lot
weeks.blurb: Design and build a classic LLD parking-lot system from a spec.

tracks.title: Python Depth
tracks.description: The Python internals interviewers probe: closures and decorators, the data model and memory, concurrency, and testing and tooling.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Functions deep dive
weeks.blurb: Closures, decorators, context managers, generators, functools and itertools.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Data model and memory
weeks.blurb: Names and references, equality and hashing, memory and stdlib data structures.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Concurrency
weeks.blurb: Threads, processes and asyncio, and when to use each.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Quality and tooling
weeks.blurb: pytest, error handling, logging, packaging and measuring code.

tracks.title: Behavioral and Career
tracks.description: The non-coding parts of the loop: behavioral stories, FDE customer scenarios, interview process, resume and portfolio, communication, and the master schedule. Read the README and schedule first, then work through it alongside everything else.

weeks.title: 01 · Behavioral fundamentals
weeks.blurb: What interviewers assess and how to build a story bank.

weeks.title: 02 · FDE customer scenarios
weeks.blurb: What a forward-deployed engineer does and how to handle customer cases.

weeks.title: 03 · Interview process and strategy
weeks.blurb: Generic loop structure, preparation strategy and negotiation notes.

weeks.title: 04 · Resume and portfolio
weeks.blurb: Resume principles and presenting projects as evidence.

weeks.title: 05 · Communication in technical interviews
weeks.blurb: How to narrate your thinking while coding and designing.

weeks.title: 06 · Master study schedule
weeks.blurb: The roughly 12-month plan at 7-8 hrs per week.

tracks.title: Data Structures and Algorithms
tracks.description: Pattern-by-pattern interview prep from Big-O to dynamic programming, with timed problem sets and tests, ending in a mock-interview capstone.
tracks.hours: ~24 weeks · 7-8 hrs/wk (2-2.5 hrs/wk alongside other tracks)

weeks.title: Week 1 · Big-O and complexity
weeks.blurb: Analysing time and space cost.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Arrays and strings
weeks.blurb: Array and string fundamentals and common techniques.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Hash maps and sets
weeks.blurb: O(1) lookups and counting patterns.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Two pointers
weeks.blurb: Moving two indices to avoid O(n^2) pair checks.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Sliding window
weeks.blurb: Maintaining a window over a contiguous slice.

weeks.title: Week 6 · Prefix sums and intervals
weeks.blurb: Prefix sums and interval problems.

weeks.title: Week 7 · Stacks
weeks.blurb: LIFO problems including monotonic stacks.

weeks.title: Week 8 · Queues and deque
weeks.blurb: FIFO queues, deque and the monotonic queue.

weeks.title: Week 9 · Linked lists
weeks.blurb: Pointer manipulation on singly linked lists.

weeks.title: Week 10 · Binary search
weeks.blurb: Halving a search space, including search on the answer.

weeks.title: Week 11 · Recursion
weeks.blurb: Recursion and an introduction to backtracking.

weeks.title: Week 12 · Sorting and checkpoint
weeks.blurb: Sorting as a tool, plus a checkpoint review.

weeks.title: Week 13 · Binary trees
weeks.blurb: Tree traversals with DFS and BFS.

weeks.title: Week 14 · Binary search trees
weeks.blurb: The BST invariant and operations.

weeks.title: Week 15 · Heaps
weeks.blurb: Priority queues with heapq and top-K problems.

weeks.title: Week 16 · Tries
weeks.blurb: Prefix trees for string sets.

weeks.title: Week 17 · Graph basics
weeks.blurb: BFS, DFS, grids and adjacency lists.

weeks.title: Week 18 · Topological sort and Union-Find
weeks.blurb: Dependency ordering and connected components.

weeks.title: Week 19 · Shortest paths
weeks.blurb: BFS, Dijkstra, 0-1 BFS and Bellman-Ford.

weeks.title: Week 20 · Backtracking
weeks.blurb: Systematic search with pruning.

weeks.title: Week 21 · 1-D dynamic programming
weeks.blurb: One-dimensional DP states.

weeks.title: Week 22 · 2-D dynamic programming
weeks.blurb: Grids, strings and knapsack.

weeks.title: Week 23 · Greedy and bit manipulation
weeks.blurb: Greedy algorithms and bit tricks.

weeks.title: Week 24 · Capstone
weeks.blurb: Mock interviews, cheat sheet, communication and prep checklist.

tracks.title: SQL
tracks.description: Querying through Python and SQLite in five weeks (SELECT to window functions to schema design), plus a language-level track on DDL/DML, internals, concurrency and warehouses.

weeks.title: Week 1 · SELECT, filter, aggregate
weeks.blurb: Single-table queries, NULL handling, aggregates and GROUP BY.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Joins and subqueries
weeks.blurb: Combining tables, fan-out and NULL traps, JOIN vs IN vs EXISTS.

weeks.title: Week 3 · CTEs, windows, CASE, dates
weeks.blurb: Multi-step queries and window functions, the most interview-heavy week.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Schema, indexes, transactions
weeks.blurb: Table design, indexing, transactions and isolation.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Interview problem set
weeks.blurb: 26 classic SQL interview problems with a method and cheatsheet.

weeks.title: General SQL
weeks.blurb: SQL as a database language beyond the weekly exercises: DDL/DML, dialects, internals, concurrency and engines. Plain .sql files, no Python.

weeks.title: Part 1 · Language map, DDL and DML
weeks.blurb: SQL sub-languages and dialects, and the statements that change schema and data.

weeks.title: Part 2 · Set ops, functions, JSON
weeks.blurb: Set operations, functions, pagination, lateral, pivot and JSON.

weeks.title: Part 3 · Objects and programmability
weeks.blurb: Views, triggers, procedures, roles and other database objects.

weeks.title: Part 4 · How databases work
weeks.blurb: Query planning, indexes and reading EXPLAIN.

weeks.title: Part 5 · Concurrency and reliability
weeks.blurb: Isolation, locks, crash recovery and safe deploys.

weeks.title: Part 6 · Engines, warehouses, modeling
weeks.blurb: How major engines differ, analytics databases and data modeling.

tracks.title: FastAPI
tracks.description: Build and ship an HTTP API: endpoints, Pydantic validation, databases and dependency injection, integrations, auth, Docker, and a ticket API project.

weeks.title: Week 1 · First endpoints
weeks.blurb: HTTP basics, routes and the auto-generated docs.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Pydantic and validation
weeks.blurb: Models, response models and error handling for messy payloads.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Database and integrations
weeks.blurb: SQLModel, dependency injection, calling APIs and webhooks (heaviest week).

weeks.title: Week 4 · Auth, deploy, project
weeks.blurb: Config, auth, logging, Docker and the ticket API project.

tracks.title: CS Fundamentals
tracks.description: Systems knowledge for interviews and customer debugging: networking, operating systems, Linux and shell, Git and CI/CD, containers and Kubernetes.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Networking
weeks.blurb: OSI/TCP-IP, IP, TCP vs UDP, DNS, HTTP, TLS and debugging tools.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Operating systems
weeks.blurb: Processes, memory, concurrency and I/O.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Linux and shell
weeks.blurb: Filesystem, permissions, processes, text tools, ssh, systemd and bash.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Git, review and CI/CD
weeks.blurb: Git workflows, code review and CI/CD pipelines.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Containers and orchestration
weeks.blurb: Linux primitives, Docker, Compose, Kubernetes and security.

tracks.title: FDE Projects
tracks.description: Six hands-on forward-deployed-engineer projects, from LLM basics to a deployed messy-data demo. Tests run offline with no API key.
tracks.hours: ~6 projects · ~2 hrs each, alongside other tracks

weeks.title: Project 1 · LLM basics
weeks.blurb: Prompts, structured output, streaming and cost.

weeks.title: Project 2 · Ticket triage
weeks.blurb: A support-ticket triage service.

weeks.title: Project 3 · Document Q&A (RAG)
weeks.blurb: Retrieval-augmented Q&A over a customer's messy files.

weeks.title: Project 4 · Tool-calling agent
weeks.blurb: An agent that uses tools over a CRM.

weeks.title: Project 5 · Evaluation
weeks.blurb: Measuring whether an LLM feature v2 is better than v1.

weeks.title: Project 6 · Capstone
weeks.blurb: From messy data to a deployed demo.

tracks.title: LLM and AI Concepts
tracks.description: Conceptual fluency for FDE and AI-engineering interviews: LLM fundamentals, RAG, agents, evaluation and production, and classic ML. Pairs with the FDE projects.

weeks.title: Week 1 · LLM fundamentals
weeks.blurb: Tokens, transformers, training, sampling, hallucination and prompting.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Retrieval and RAG
weeks.blurb: Designing, debugging and defending RAG systems.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Agents and tool use
weeks.blurb: Function calling, agent loops, reliability and safety.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Evaluation and production
weeks.blurb: Measuring, observing, optimising and securing LLM features.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Classic ML essentials
weeks.blurb: Supervised and unsupervised learning, error and evaluation basics.

tracks.title: Low-Level Design
tracks.description: Eight classic LLD interview problems, each with a talk-through lesson, exercises and deterministic tests.

weeks.title: Problem 1 · LRU cache
weeks.blurb: Dict plus doubly linked list with O(1) operations.

weeks.title: Problem 2 · Rate limiter
weeks.blurb: Pluggable algorithms such as token bucket and sliding window.

weeks.title: Problem 3 · Elevator system
weeks.blurb: State machine, stop ordering and dispatch policy.

weeks.title: Problem 4 · Vending machine
weeks.blurb: The State pattern and correct money handling.

weeks.title: Problem 5 · Seat booking
weeks.blurb: Holds and locks to avoid double-booking.

weeks.title: Problem 6 · Game engine
weeks.blurb: Board games such as NxN tic-tac-toe and chess-lite.

weeks.title: Problem 7 · Pub-sub and notifications
weeks.blurb: Observer, channel strategies, retries and dead letters.

weeks.title: Problem 8 · Expense sharing
weeks.blurb: Splitwise-style splits, ledger and debt simplification.

tracks.title: AWS
tracks.description: Interview-level AWS fundamentals in six weeks of reading and spoken Q&A, with optional labs and an FDE-angle finale.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Core ideas and IAM
weeks.blurb: Global infrastructure, shared responsibility, IAM, STS, Organizations, billing.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Compute
weeks.blurb: EC2, Lambda, containers, Beanstalk, ELB and Auto Scaling.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Storage and databases
weeks.blurb: S3, block and file storage, RDS, DynamoDB, caches and warehouses.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Networking
weeks.blurb: VPC, security groups, endpoints, Route 53, CloudFront and connectivity.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Integration, ops, security
weeks.blurb: Messaging, Step Functions, API Gateway, monitoring, IaC, KMS and WAF.

weeks.title: Week 6 · Architecture and FDE angle
weeks.blurb: Well-Architected Framework, scenarios and a mock interview.

tracks.title: System Design
tracks.description: High-level design for Google/Uber-level interviews: estimation, storage, messaging, distributed algorithms, operations, and eight full designs with a mock interview.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Fundamentals
weeks.blurb: Estimation, scalability, availability, load balancing and caching.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Data and storage
weeks.blurb: Replication, sharding, SQL vs NoSQL and consistency.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Coordination and messaging
weeks.blurb: Queues, logs, delivery semantics and resilience patterns.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Distributed algorithms
weeks.blurb: Consensus, time, coordination and probabilistic structures.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Architecture and operations
weeks.blurb: Services, APIs, observability, deploys, multi-region, security, LLM systems.

weeks.title: Week 6 · HLD designs
weeks.blurb: Framework, eight full design walkthroughs and a mock interview.

tracks.title: Data Engineering
tracks.description: Senior data engineer interview prep: dimensional modeling, Spark, Airflow and dbt, Kafka and streaming, lakehouse formats, data quality and governance, and pipeline design.

weeks.title: Week 1 · Modeling and warehousing
weeks.blurb: Star schemas, SCDs, Kimball vs Data Vault, warehouses and ELT.

weeks.title: Week 2 · Spark
weeks.blurb: Execution model, shuffles, joins, skew and tuning.

weeks.title: Week 3 · Orchestration and dbt
weeks.blurb: Airflow, idempotent and incremental loads, backfills, dbt.

weeks.title: Week 4 · Kafka and streaming
weeks.blurb: Logs, consumer groups, delivery semantics, windows and watermarks.

weeks.title: Week 5 · Lakehouse and formats
weeks.blurb: Parquet, Delta, Iceberg, Hudi, partitioning and compaction.

weeks.title: Week 6 · Quality and governance
weeks.blurb: Data checks, contracts, observability, PII and erasure.

weeks.title: Week 7 · Pipeline design
weeks.blurb: A design framework and eight data-platform walkthroughs.
